title: More Than Optimized
description: Squeeze out every singe frame possible
body:
# Extreme FPS Optimization Modpack

An extreme optimization-focused modpack built to **squeeze out as much FPS as humanly possible** from Minecraft.

## Performance First

This modpack is designed for one main purpose:

> **Maximum FPS. Maximum smoothness. Minimum unnecessary load.**

It focuses on improving Minecraft’s performance by reducing rendering overhead, optimizing game systems, and removing unnecessary lag wherever possible.

## FPS Results

On my setup:

| Setup                          |          FPS |
| ------------------------------ | -----------: |
| **Vanilla / Normal Minecraft** |  **510 FPS** |
| **With this modpack**          | **1184 FPS** |

That is **more than double the FPS**, making the game feel much smoother, faster, and more responsive.

## What This Modpack Is For

This pack is perfect for players who want:

* **Higher framerates**
* **Smoother gameplay**
* **Better responsiveness**
* **Less stuttering**
* **Improved performance on high-refresh-rate monitors**
* **A lightweight Minecraft experience without gameplay clutter**

## Description

If you want Minecraft to run as fast as possible, this modpack is made for you.

It is an extreme performance pack focused entirely on pushing FPS to the limit. No unnecessary features, no bloated gameplay changes, and no extra clutter — just pure optimization aimed at making Minecraft run faster, smoother, and more efficiently.

Whether you are trying to get the most out of a powerful PC or make Minecraft feel better on lower-end hardware, this pack is built to help maximize performance.

## Whats the objective for this modpack
The reason I made this modpack is so other people can play minecraft more smoothly, I make no money from this modpack!
